availability_rule: historical actual_release_date must be strictly earlier than current forecast_date
benchmark_inference: primary interval score minus benchmark interval score; Newey-West HAC SE with Bartlett weights and bandwidth floor(4*(n/100)^(2/9)); negative favors primary
calibration_scope: same target, same forecast stage, same frozen selected model
fallback_rule: none; cells below minimum history are H4-ineligible
gaussian_rmse_definition: Phi^-1(0.90) times sqrt(mean prior signed-error squared), centered on point forecast
history_rule: all prior finite errors satisfying the release-date gate are eligible before application of the domain rolling window; development, embargo, and earlier evaluation errors may enter once observable
rolling_q80_definition: absolute-error empirical 0.80 quantile with NumPy method=higher
sample_rule: stage-specific evaluation; no complete-stage balancing requirement
